prior_art.literature: Web searches (Hungarian: Pongracz Janos Karolyi Sandor 1710 titkosiras; Lang Benedek Rakoczi rejtjelezes Pongracz) found no study of this letter; Lang, 'Real Life Cryptology' (2015) and the AETAS 2014 article treat the Karolyi-Bercsenyi sign system, and I did not find Pongracz named in the search results.

vetting.key_check: No key held here. The Pongracz sign system as shown in Revay's interlinear (sister letter, Commons scan) and the keys in the Karolyi fonds are candidates once a leaf is imaged; none was tested because no image of no. 9027 is online.
vetting.key_held: Commons scan 'Encrypted letter to Francis II Rákóczi, 1710-09-15.jpg' (Revay 1974, with interlinear decipherment per the earlier note): the Pongracz sign system as deciphered for a different letter; not tested on no. 9027 (no image). Per the 3 Nov 2026 rule it does not block.
vetting.key_in_volume: Same fonds P 396: no. 11345 'kulcsok Rakoczi leveleiben hasznalt titkosirasokhoz' (a 19th-c. sheet of keys to the ciphers in Rakoczi's letters), no. 10543 'Titkos iras feloldo kulcsok (4 fol.)' and a 1704 key sheet (as recorded in the vetting of catalogue 1902); none imaged, none tested.
vetting.duplicates: known.py on 'Pongr', 'Karolyi', 'P 396', 'Ujvar': no catalogue entry, lead or target for no. 9027; sibling lead 1904 is three other letters (nos. 7950-7952, July 1710), catalogue 1902 and no. 10924 are other letters; the Commons Pongracz letter is to Rakoczi, not in P 396.
